subject: Integration preflight — SDK handshake and next steps

Hi Samantha / Oliver,

Thanks again for signing up for the Redwood trial — excited to get you unblocked. We have your office-hours slot on the calendar for Tue Aug 18 at 10:00 AM PT (13:00 ET). This session is intended to cover:

- API key handshake and basic auth test (curl example)
- Quick SDK install and sample call
- Troubleshooting a 401 / token mismatch if you hit it

Before we meet, can you please:
1) Confirm which SDK you plan to use (python/js)
2) Bring the curl output (or SDK debug log) if you see an error

I attached a short preflight checklist and a sample request you can paste into your terminal. If anything changes, reply here and we can reschedule — otherwise I’ll be in the meeting room at the time below.

Calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/monica/30min?slot=20260818T100000PT
